g.title: j1575799791
g.text: I do not think I can adequately describe to you how strange a moment it was to inject the serum, mon miracle.

g.title: j3480757021
g.text: I've heard it's incredibly painful.

g.title: j2064507072
g.text: I can't possibly imagine.

g.title: j1133628288
g.text: [Warning: Brief mentions of self-harm and child abuse. Click here to end. No loss of Chemistry with Lyon will be incurred.]

g.title: j3738420479
g.text: [จบ]

g.title: j4075781927
g.text: Boolean LyonWillDate is now true.

g.title: j477445651
g.text: I suppose so. Though I do believe that I have had years of practice in that regard and, therefore, Entrati's warnings made it to be far more impressive than it was in actuality.

g.title: j2231872233
g.text: Marie and I decided to take our serums in private. I asked her to allow me to go first, experience the change, and then to help guide her through her own - but she, of course, steadfastly refused.

g.title: j1843578849
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j3856020424
g.text: Boolean LyonConfessionFail is now true.

g.title: Chat ends. Next chat will be Lyon5FaithDay2.
g.text: Chat ends. Next chat will be Lyon5FaithDay2.

j3397592238
g.text: Scoffing at the mere notion that I would go anywhere or do anything without her firmly planted at my side, she headed off to her own chambers.

g.title: j2698387260
g.text: Boolean LyonFamilySuccess is now true.

g.title: j2038319619
g.text: I locked my door, stripped, and sat in the middle of my floor, as far away from any objects as I could, before I drove the needle into my side.

g.title: j2559080857
g.text: Boolean LyonRell3 is now true.

g.title: j222758957
g.text: I had seen what the Infestation had done to Roathe, twisting his flesh with whatever he must have been wearing at the time - I had no desire to fall victim of the same fate.

g.title: j4008758555
g.text: Boolean LyonFaith3Unknown is now true.

g.title: j3500730294
g.text: When the agony was over, my already suffering vision was... blurred. Overtaken in... double, somehow? As though I could see not once, but twice.

g.title: j4008758555->Chat ends. Next chat will be Lyon5FaithDay2.
j2489265345
g.text: I am quite proud of my resilience, however, that I managed to don my britches before I retched and unconsciousness took me.

g.title: j4235948116
g.text: When I awoke, I was not alone. Nor, however, was I on the floor of my chambers. I was sitting in my childhood bedroom upon the creaky old floors I knew so well.

g.title: j836425301
g.text: And sitting beside me was a young man. Beside him stood a figure I now know as Harrow. The young man was holding a small wooden figurine in his hands. It was jointed at the limbs - the paint long worn away, save perhaps in the creases and cracks. It had belonged to my father. It was of a soldier.

g.title: j3212008715
g.text: It was the only toy I could claim as my own, as a child.

g.title: j2645404915
g.text: I had a similar figurine, growing up. It was one of my favorite toys.

g.title: j1631219762
g.text: Rell?

g.title: j3902846273
g.text: So I have heard. I believe mine proved to be more benign, in the end.

g.title: j3620206392
g.text: Indeed.

g.title: j3373639179
g.text: Thrax is a complicated topic. I'd rather not get into it here.

g.title: j4253532521
g.text: It wasn't his fault, really. He was just who I needed him to be in that moment in time.

g.title: j325421531
g.text: It's okay. He's progressing. Slowly. Somehow. The seemingly impossible can change.

g.title: j3635917176
g.text: The young man and his silent guardian who visited me inside my dream- inside my mind - were all at once strangers to me and yet known to me like we had grown up together as siblings.

g.title: j4276712307
g.text: Quite right. We could be lost here for hours, debating the moral and theological implications of Duviri.

g.title: j458911878
g.text: When I ponder even the smallest notion of what I would have conjured in your stead, I am overcome with waves of horror. But we could be lost here for hours, discussing such a thing.

g.title: j2747438730
g.text: If he is showing signs of change, and he is a product of your emotions, perhaps that is indicative of something else. But a debate for another day, perhaps.

g.title: j2864445148
g.text: Forgive me for an overwrought metaphor, but it was as though we were three trees whose roots were so grown together as to become indistinguishable from one another -

g.title: j1079986156
g.text: who had merely been blinked into existence in such a state. I could remember my life without Rell and Harrow. And yet, there they were. In every moment - in every instance - beside me.

g.title: j4227795077
g.text: As an aside, I wish I could speak to Entrati about this, I am desperate to know what manner of science is at the - no pun intended - root of this, but when we finally recovered from our change, Entrati was gone.

g.title: j1937133691
g.text: Check boolean LoidFamilyComplete

g.title: j3116301787
g.text: What little I know of the Infestation and how it works, it seems to be kind of... maybe... I don't know, outside time?

g.title: j1937133691->j3116301787
g.text: true

g.title: j1937133691->j3116301787
g.text: false

g.title: j1378396093
g.text: Entrati's daughter is upstairs. She studied and worked beside him. She might be able to help.

g.title: j1937133691->j1378396093
g.text: false

g.title: j1571057733
g.text: There's a... guitar... it's all very hard to explain, and we've both traveled through time via Helminth...

g.title: j122481226
g.text: Boolean LyonFamilySuccess is now true.

g.title: j3137520430
g.text: Which was a process I believe will linger in my nightmares for a very long time. Regardless, the specifics of how it is that Rell, Harrow, and I became bonded at such a... molecular, spiritual level, I do not know.

g.title: j538400272
g.text: Add 1 to Family counter

g.title: j3333162315
g.text: But the crossroads went both ways. Where they were in my life, I was in theirs. I saw the Indifference. I understood what they were standing guard against. I saw glimpses of Harrow, and the man he once was.

g.title: j3224449827
g.text: Now if only we were allowed to speak to her. I suspect there are schemes to that effect already in play. If so, you may count on me to... assist. I can be convincing when need be.

g.title: j2426564199
g.text: But the press of the Indifference took over I could feel it there - hear it as they did, tapping against the walls. Rap... tap... tap...

g.title: j2502653121
g.text: Regardless, the specifics of how it is that Rell, Harrow, and I became bonded at such a... molecular, spiritual level, I do not know.

g.title: j1858108996
g.text: All the visions of my youth, all the horrors that I had seen - were they only ever the Indifference? Was I now mis-remembering? Or had I indeed been "blessed" by Lua?

g.title: j623392025
g.text: My faith inside of me... it crumpled and fell away. Nothing more than charred paper, turned to dust. And oh, how I loathe myself for my weakness...

g.title: j2547210604
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j1450013210
g.text: Oh, Lyon... you've been through so much. Doubt isn't the result of weakness - doubt is the result of pain.

g.title: j2547210604->j1450013210
g.text: LyonDating

g.title: j910090015
g.text: Faith doesn't need to be constant - nor is it expected to be. How many tales are told of those who lose their faith, only to find it again?

g.title: j2547210604->j910090015
g.text: DrifterFaithYesSimilar

g.title: j2547210604->j910090015
g.text: DrifterFaithYesForeign

g.title: j2547210604->j910090015
g.text: DrifterFaithPersonal

g.title: j2333831460
g.text: You spent your life in dedication to our Luminaries, Lyon. Do you think they would turn away from you for something like this?

g.title: j2547210604->j2333831460
g.text: DrifterFaithSol

g.title: j2547210604->j2333831460
g.text: DrifterFaithLua

g.title: j2547210604->j2333831460
g.text: DrifterFaithBalance

g.title: j928692881
g.text: I don't know if there are gods or not, Lyon - I don't think any of us can ever truly know. But what I do know, is that you've been through a great deal.

g.title: j2547210604->j928692881
g.text: DrifterFaithAgnostic

g.title: j4183919341
g.text: While I personally don't believe there are gods in this world, I know how important that has been to you in your life. I don't want to belittle that.

g.title: j2547210604->j4183919341
g.text: DrifterFaithNoFear

g.title: j2547210604->j4183919341
g.text: DrifterFaithNoMaybe

g.title: j1209849483
g.text: The Indifference was made by us - he isn't a god, Lyon. Don't let Entrati's mistake destroy you. As for your faith?

g.title: j2547210604->j1209849483
g.text: DrifterFaithNoMITW

g.title: j3738305794
g.text: I hate to see you like this, caught in the middle of everyone's nonsense. You didn't deserve this.

g.title: j2547210604->j3738305794
g.text: false

g.title: j3946494602
g.text: I'm not saying you need to find your faith again. I'm saying if you want to - if you feel you need to - it's not something that's forever lost.

g.title: j1790536478
g.text: Surely, Lua can see what you've been put through. What you've endured in her name.

g.title: j1655976617
g.text: What I think is that you need to focus on is finding some kind of peace within yourself - however it is you need to find it.

g.title: j2817354629
g.text: If there is a god, if your Lua does exist - surely she can see what you've been through. What you've endured in her name. It must mean something to her.

g.title: j637121358
g.text: I think you need to let go of any notion of whether or not there are gods, and focus on healing yourself, first.

g.title: j4235733650
g.text: Boolean LyonFaith3Maybe is now true.

g.title: j188402280
g.text: Boolean LyonFaith3Yes is now true.

g.title: j683185276
g.text: Boolean LyonFaith3No is now true.

g.title: j3511376472
g.text: Perhaps you are right... And my sad tale of doubt was hardly the point. But I shall consider your words. We shall discuss this in more detail tomorrow.

g.title: j1576450928
g.text: I saw Rell's life aboard the Zariman Ten Zero, and all that he endured after it. I saw Harrow's life as a soldier, faded as it was through the Infestation. Just as they saw my life in Gaule and all I suffered.

g.title: j2158651767
g.text: It may be strange to you to know that none of us ever once exchanged a word. We never found the need. There was simply between us an... understanding.

g.title: j1483766189
g.text: Really? Never?

g.title: j1829119266
g.text: Yeah... I can see that.

g.title: j3624410421
g.text: I could hear their voices - I knew all the words in their lives they had ever spoken. But they were never directed to me.

g.title: j1889145319
g.text: Does a smile need a speech? Does a frown? Do you need to hear a child weeping to know he is in pain or frightened? No, we merely knew what was passed between us.

g.title: j2276490866
g.text: Until it... until it no longer was.

g.title: j944777217
g.text: Check boolean LyonDating

g.title: j321595824
g.text: They are not gone, mon miracle... only dead.

g.title: j944777217->j321595824
g.text: true

g.title: j3922430130
g.text: They are not gone, my friend... only dead.

g.title: j944777217->j3922430130
g.text: false

g.title: j427780658
g.text: I can no longer hear those parts of them which were undetermined. Now, I believe, I can only hear that part of them which were.

g.title: j2172462837
g.text: I'm sorry, determined?

g.title: j2128846340
g.text: When did you... stop hearing him?

g.title: j390834133
g.text: I cannot explain it any more than I already have. I know not how. Forgive me.

g.title: j2831203698
g.text: The moment we passed through the Helminth with Roathe and came here, to the Sanctum. I do not know... why. Or how.

g.title: j1200649692
g.text: But in passing through that veil of time, my friends, my brothers.. the trees whose roots wove through my soul so closely... withered and died beside me.

g.title: j3073340071
g.text: Now an emptiness is there. Rotting. The memory of them still corrupting my own. But I would not give it away if I had the chance...

g.title: j2539057934
g.text: Oh?

g.title: j1710257358
g.text: Why not?

g.title: j1466462965
g.text: I can recall the memory of the first time my mother struck me. I remember it two ways, clear as Sol's brightest light, and I know all versions are true.

g.title: j3137497417
g.text: In one... I weep alone in the darkness of my room. In another, two figures stand beside me in the shadows.

g.title: j3990130693
g.text: I remember twice the first time I took a blade to my skin to clear the voices from my mind. In one, the room is empty.

g.title: j672011164
g.text: In another, I hear a humming from behind me. I feel the silent presence of a stoic guardian.

g.title: j3314496750
g.text: If I have lost my faith in my goddess of Lua and have gained their guidance in return... it may be a trade I would be willing to give.

g.title: j2400849994
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j2266721226
g.text: I'm just - I'm just so sorry for what both of you have had to go through.

g.title: j2400849994->j2266721226
g.text: LyonDating

g.title: j2400849994->j2266721226
g.text: DrifterFaithYesSimilar

g.title: j2400849994->j2266721226
g.text: DrifterFaithYesForeign

g.text: DrifterFaithPersonal

g.text: DrifterFaithSol

g.text: DrifterFaithBalance

g.text: DrifterFaithAgnostic

g.title: j2400849994->j2266721226
g.text: DrifterFaithNoFear

g.title: j2400849994->j2266721226
g.text: DrifterFaithNoMITW

g.title: j2400849994->j2266721226
g.text: DrifterFaithNoMaybe

g.title: j2400849994->j2266721226
g.text: false

g.title: j420251458
g.text: I'm just... so glad Rell and Harrow could be there with you, Lyon... even if it was in memories.

g.title: j2400849994->j420251458
g.text: LyonDating

g.title: j848706734
g.text: Could you consider the possibility that... maybe this is all the work of a god or gods? To comfort you?

g.title: j2400849994->j848706734
g.text: DrifterFaithYesSimilar

g.title: j2400849994->j848706734
g.text: DrifterFaithYesForeign

g.title: j2400849994->j848706734
g.text: DrifterFaithPersonal

g.title: j3642227627
g.text: Could you consider the possibility that... maybe this is all the work of Lua? To comfort you?

g.title: j2400849994->j3642227627
g.text: DrifterFaithSol

g.title: j2400849994->j3642227627
g.text: DrifterFaithLua

g.title: j2400849994->j3642227627
g.text: DrifterFaithBalance

g.title: j1744839659
g.text: I don't know as the two have to be mutually exclusive, but... I don't know. I don't know as we ever will.

g.title: j2400849994->j1744839659
g.text: DrifterFaithAgnostic

g.title: j791721280
g.text: I'm just... so glad Rell and Harrow could be there with you, Lyon... even if it was in memories.

g.title: j2400849994->j791721280
g.text: DrifterFaithNoFear

g.title: j2400849994->j791721280
g.text: DrifterFaithNoMITW

g.title: j2400849994->j791721280
g.text: DrifterFaithNoMaybe

g.title: j2400849994->j791721280
g.text: false

g.title: j787127047
g.text: Thank you. I miss their presence. But I... am learning that in this place, there are more who might understand my pain than not.

g.title: j2779457497
g.text: Thank you. I miss their presence. But I am... no longer alone, am I, mon miracle?

g.title: j3086494386
g.text: Yes. Do not think I have not considered it. I am not sure if my faith will be so easily mended, but... it is a comfort to ponder, all the same.

g.title: j510677876
g.text: Indeed. Do not think I have not considered whether or not Rell and Harrow were sent by the Luminaries to comfort me. But as you said, such is not for us to know.

g.title: j3848321264
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j406946127
g.text: I am so very relieved to finally have spoken of all this with you. It is a great burden, lifted from me, and I cannot express my gratitude enough.

g.title: j918154824
g.text: Check boolean LyonDating

g.title: j329402857
g.text: For now, I must go, mon miracle.

g.title: j918154824->j329402857
g.text: true

g.title: j3512697969
g.text: For now, I must go, my friend.

g.title: j918154824->j3512697969
